decisions.reason: As a complementary care product that gained its own page by 2024, it shows enough visible commitment and fit with the firm's flooring system offer that management would likely continue it.
Although it remained only mentioned on the website, this maintenance-oil line extends the established aftercare business and its multiple models suggest enough prior investment to favor persistence.
This care line for oiled floors both fits closely with the core flooring business and received stronger standalone presentation in 2024, making withdrawal relatively unlikely.

The underlay with moisture protection is less publicly emphasized, so it is somewhat easier to remove, but as a practical add-on within the firm's installation system management would still tend to retain it.

This underlay foam appears to carry the weakest visible public commitment and is likely easier to substitute or rationalize, yet its adjacency to the core offer still makes continuation more likely than discontinuation.

An oak parquet line sits very near the firm's core business, likely involves meaningful production and range investment, and aligns with its innovation and growth direction, so management would strongly prefer to keep it.
